description: channel-google-chat's section of the Settings dialog: A Google Chat app of your own (a Workspace add-on) answers in each message's thread: Thinking… written as the model writes, tables and code as cards, photos and files read, questions asked with buttons and forms. On a server or on Cloudflare. Its settings come with the component (pikit add channel-google-chat), stored by settings-store.
